subject.title: fix(gateway): bound connect frame auth.* fields at the protocol schema

question: Should this PR bound all six connect-frame auth fields at the protocol schema, and should those bounds be enforced by bytes/token shape rather than TypeBox grapheme `maxLength`?
rationale: This is a valid pre-auth hardening direction, but it changes a public gateway protocol validation boundary and the current implementation does not enforce the byte work limit claimed by the security fix.

options.title: Fix byte caps and cover all fields
options.body: Require byte or token-shape validation plus direct at-cap and over-cap coverage for all six changed auth fields before merge.

options.title: Narrow to bootstrap/device tokens
options.body: Keep this PR focused on the proven iterated-token amplification path and leave shared/runtime token caps for a separate protocol decision.

options.title: Accept partial hardening explicitly
options.body: Gateway/security owners may accept the grapheme caps and runtime-token compatibility tradeoff, but that should be an explicit merge decision.

recommendation.title: Fix byte caps and cover all fields
recommendation.body: Require byte or token-shape validation plus direct at-cap and over-cap coverage for all six changed auth fields before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The gateway protocol package history and docs ownership make this the best available person-level routing candidate, with security review still needed for the boundary decision.
